u1-i-а-identity: The capital shapes can look the same, but this card belongs to the Cyrillic alphabet. Latin A is a letter of a different alphabet.
Р has a vertical stem and an upper loop. А has two sloping sides and a crossbar.
u1-i-м-identity: Н has two upright strokes joined by a horizontal crossbar. М has inner diagonal strokes.
Т has a top bar and a central stem. It does not have the inner diagonal strokes of М.
u1-i-р-not-p: The capital shapes can look the same, but this is a Cyrillic letter card. The Latin name P does not name the Russian letter.
П has two uprights joined across the top. Р has an upper loop attached to its stem.
u1-i-н-not-h: The similar capital shape does not give this Cyrillic letter the Latin name H. Identify it within the Russian alphabet.
И joins its uprights with a diagonal. Н uses a horizontal crossbar instead.
u1-i-с-not-c: The similar capital shapes belong to different alphabets. The Latin name C does not identify this Cyrillic letter.
К has diagonal arms extending from a straight stem. С is an open curved shape.
u1-i-в-not-b: The Latin capital B looks similar, but this is a Cyrillic letter card. A Latin letter name does not identify it.
Б has a top horizontal stroke and one lower bowl. В has two bowls.
u1-i-у-not-y: The Latin capital Y may look similar, but this card belongs to the Cyrillic alphabet. Use the Cyrillic identity.
И has two upright strokes joined diagonally. У has an upper fork and a descending tail.
u1-i-х-not-x: The matching shape does not make this the Latin letter X. This card belongs to the Cyrillic alphabet.
К has a vertical stem with two arms. Х consists of two crossing diagonal strokes.
u1-i-е-identity: Э opens toward the left. Е has its upright stroke on the left and its horizontal strokes extend to the right.
Ё has two dots above the Е shape. The shown Е has no dots.
u1-i-ё-identity: Е has the same main shape but no dots. The two dots distinguish the shown Ё.
Э opens toward the left and has no dots. Ё has the Е shape with two dots above it.
u1-i-ю-identity: У has an upper fork and a descending tail. Ю has an upright joined to a rounded part.
Я has a loop and a diagonal leg. Ю has an upright and a rounded part side by side.
u1-i-я-identity: Р has its loop on the right of the stem. Я has a loop on the left and a diagonal leg.
А has two sloping sides and a crossbar. Я combines a stem, a loop and a diagonal leg.
u1-i-ь-not-vowel: The soft sign does not supply a separate vowel sound. Compare it with the vowel letters in the signs explanation.
Ъ is the hard sign. Ь is the soft sign; they are different letters with different functions.
u1-i-ъ-not-vowel: The hard sign does not supply a separate vowel sound. It is distinct from the vowel letters.
Ь is the soft sign. The shown Ъ has an additional upper stroke and is the hard sign.
u1-i-й-not-vowel: Й is short I and is classified here as a consonant. It is distinct from the vowel И.
Ь is the soft sign. Й has a short mark above the И shape and is a different letter.
u1-i-print-pair: Р pairs with р; п pairs with П. This option joins two different letters.
Н pairs with н; и pairs with И. The diagonal in и is different from the crossbar of н.
u1-i-decode-pair: А and О are different letters. Changing the case of А produces а, not О.
М and Т are different letters. Their lowercase partners are м and т, respectively.
u1-i-name-be: This is the name of В (VE), not Б (BE). The printed card shows Б.
This names П (PE), whose capital has two uprights and a top bar. The printed card shows Б (BE).
u2-i-в-not-b: Б pairs with б. The shown в pairs with В; compare the two bowls of в with the shape of б.
Р pairs with р, which has a stem and a loop. It does not pair with the two-bowl в.
u2-i-у-not-y: Ч pairs with ч. The shown у has the descending tail of the У / у pair.
Ц pairs with ц, with two uprights and a short lower extension. The shown у belongs to У / у.
u2-i-х-not-x: Ж pairs with ж, whose strokes branch on both sides. The shown х has two crossing diagonals and pairs with Х.
К pairs with к, with arms extending from an upright. The shown х has two crossing diagonals.
u2-i-я-identity: Р pairs with р. The loop and diagonal leg in я identify the Я / я pair.
А pairs with а. The shown я is the lowercase partner of Я.
u2-i-print-б: В pairs with в, not б. The lowercase б is the partner of Б.
Б pairs with б, not в. The lowercase в is the partner of В.

variantPrompt: Which uppercase Cyrillic letter pairs with this lowercase print form?
unitTwoTeachingBody: Match each lowercase print form to its uppercase partner. Compare the strokes in both parts of each letter-board pair. A similar-looking letter from the Latin alphabet is not a substitute for a Cyrillic letter. Use the worked examples to practise the case pairs, then identify the pair for the form on the check card.
remainingScope: Missing model audio/pronunciation, true decoding, Latin-script ambiguity and other weak Unit1 tasks remain OPEN. These 46 authored explanations are pending independent linguistic review, not accepted facts merely because display tests pass.
